description: Ask the game godot_session started. op: tree (the live node tree), get (values now), set (a Node.property), call (a method), eval (a Godot Expression on the scene root), step (run `frames` with an `input` timeline counted from this step, sample `watch`, stop early `until` a condition holds; the same frame-exact input as godot_play), signals (record them; later steps list when they fired), layout (3D objects: position, size, and whether each rests on, floats above or sinks into what is below, plus scale mistakes), ray (what a physics ray from-to hits), ui (visible controls at window `sizes`: clipped text, off-screen panels, overlapping buttons, small targets), errors (what the game printed since the last call), reload (load edited scripts into the running game: nodes keep their values and run the new code from the next step; a script that does not compile stays as it was). Every answer ends with the new errors and warnings, runtime errors with their call chain. Time only moves on a step, so the session is deterministic. Use it to try a fix live, reach a state that is hard to reach, or watch a long scenario in parts.

every.description: step: sample every n frames (default: about 10 samples)

files.description: reload: res:// scripts to reload (default: every script changed since the session started or the last reload)

input.description: step: "0 press jump; 10 release jump; 20 hold right 30"

node.description: call: node path from the scene root

path.description: project folder, or a file or folder inside it (relative to the server's folder; default: the current project)

root.description: tree and layout: start at this node (default the scene root)

sizes.description: ui: window sizes such as 1280x720 or 720x1280 (default the size the project sets)

until.description: step: stop at the first frame where this holds, "Hero.is_on_floor() == true"

value.description: set: the new value as Godot writes it, e.g. Vector3(0, 30, 0)

watch.description: get and step: values to read, e.g. "Hero.position", "Hero.is_on_floor()"

name: godot_game
title: Look at and drive the running game session
